newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Changchai B share posts early gain.
newsitem.headline: Changchai B share posts early gain.

text.p: Diesel engine maker Changchai Co Ltd's 100 million class B shares were listed in Shenzhen on Friday and posted a strong gain in the early morning.

The counter opened at HK$5.35 and was traded at HK$5.30 per share at 10:10 a.m. That compared with its recent offer price of HK$4.97 per share. The issue hit a high of HK$5.40 and a low of HK$5.18 on active trade of 3.80 million shares.
Brokers said they expect the counter to gain about 10 percent in Friday's trading.
